# Aaron Ontoyin Yin

> AI researcher at Vela Partners (San Francisco, remote from Accra, Ghana). Builds
> decision-making systems that learn from data. Applying to PhD programs for Fall 2027
> in reinforcement learning, continual learning, deep learning, and robotics.

Site: https://aaron-yin.com/ · Email: aarononto909@gmail.com
ORCID: 0009-0002-9142-5890 · Google Scholar: user yHKw5EcAAAAJ
GitHub: https://github.com/Aaron-Ontoyin · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aarononto/

## Summary

Aaron Ontoyin Yin builds decision-making systems that learn from data. His current work
uses large language models to construct interpretable classifiers and decision rules from
unstructured data, and benchmarks to test them. He wants to work next on reinforcement
learning and continual learning for LLM-based and robotic agents.

At Vela Partners since January 2024, he builds and maintains the research group's dataset
of tens of thousands of startups and their founders, built the founder-success prediction
models in production at the firm (precision about ten times the 1.9% base rate), and started
think-reason-learn, the group's open-source LLM-native machine-learning framework. He has
co-authored eight papers with the group and is an inventor on the GPTree patent application
(US 19/357,996). The group publishes with collaborators at the University of Oxford.

He holds a B.Sc. in Electrical & Electronic Engineering (First Class, 3.91/4.0) from the
University of Mines and Technology, Tarkwa, Ghana. He led software development for UMaT's
Drillbotics entries, which won the virtual-rig directional-drilling category in 2023 and the
well-control category in 2024.

  Alican, Ihlamur. https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.24622

  Griffin, Yin, Ihlamur. Manuscript under revision, 2026.
  https://vela.partners/research/cost-aware-sequential-evaluation
